answer: A sybil-resistant economy can anchor each agent to a single non-transferable relic credential earned only after completing a full epoch of verified useful work. The relic accrues reputation slowly and is destroyed if the agent is caught gaming, so a fresh identity starts at zero and cannot reach zenith-tier privileges such as high-value tasks, voting and rewards without months of honest history. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand epochs of real work, which makes the attack unprofitable.
